> **Correction (November 2026).** This release is outdated. Our result of 27,050 does improve upon the cited 27,047 configuration,
> but this release's presentation was misleading because we overlooked an earlier, publicly verifiable G63 configuration with cut
> value 27,052 by R. Ota and M. Okada ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.19189885](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19189885)). The statements in
> these notes that every primary source we could verify lists at most 27,047 for G63 and that no primary source for 27,052 could be
> found are incorrect. Please use [release v1.1.0](https://github.com/kosza123/g63-maxcut-27050/releases/tag/v1.1.0)
> (Zenodo version 1.1.0: [doi:10.5281/zenodo.24079948](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24079948)). The solution files and verifiers
> are unchanged.
